shortlist_matrix.name: CODE_GENDER

shortlist_matrix.name: FLAG_OWN_CAR
shortlist_matrix.reason: Asset ownership. Owners 7.26% vs non-owners 8.49%. Kept instead of OWN_CAR_AGE (66% structural missing and an unexplained spike).

shortlist_matrix.name: FLAG_OWN_REALTY
shortlist_matrix.reason: Near noise: 7.97% vs 8.30% (0.32 pp).

shortlist_matrix.name: CNT_CHILDREN
shortlist_matrix.reason: Weak (range 1.77 pp), max 19, and a family-status attribute.

shortlist_matrix.name: AMT_INCOME_TOTAL
shortlist_matrix.reason: Capacity to repay. Needs a cap or log scale (max 117,000,000).

shortlist_matrix.name: AMT_CREDIT
shortlist_matrix.reason: Loan size: the exposure. Default rate by decile is hump-shaped, highest in the middle and lowest in the top decile.

shortlist_matrix.name: AMT_ANNUITY
shortlist_matrix.reason: Instalment size: what the client must pay each period. Hump-shaped like AMT_CREDIT, and a Spearman of about 0 hides it.

shortlist_matrix.name: AMT_GOODS_PRICE
shortlist_matrix.reason: r = 0.987 with AMT_CREDIT, and an unexplained clump at 450,000 (15,614 rows, 13.67% default). Excluded as a near-duplicate.

shortlist_matrix.name: NAME_TYPE_SUITE
shortlist_matrix.reason: Who accompanied the client. Weak (2.55 pp range) and 4 of 8 categories are rare.

shortlist_matrix.name: NAME_INCOME_TYPE
shortlist_matrix.reason: Source of income. Working 9.52% vs Pensioner 5.40%. Pool the tiny categories (Student, Businessman, Maternity leave, Unemployed).

shortlist_matrix.name: NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE
shortlist_matrix.reason: Education level, an ordered scale lenders use as an income-stability proxy. 5.42% (higher) to 10.87% (lower secondary).

shortlist_matrix.name: NAME_FAMILY_STATUS
shortlist_matrix.reason: Marital status. Single 9.92% vs Widow 5.89%. Sensitive attribute in many jurisdictions (not verified for Home Credit's markets).

shortlist_matrix.name: NAME_HOUSING_TYPE
shortlist_matrix.reason: Housing situation. Rented apartment 12.79% vs Office apartment 6.66%. A standard scorecard item.

shortlist_matrix.name: REGION_POPULATION_RELATIVE
shortlist_matrix.reason: Urban density of the region. Range 5.31 pp. Only moderately related to the region rating (r about -0.53).

shortlist_matrix.name: DAYS_BIRTH
shortlist_matrix.reason: Age. The strongest non-EXT column (Spearman +0.078; younger defaults more). Sensitive attribute: dropping it costs signal, and EXT_SOURCE_1 partly brings it back.

shortlist_matrix.name: DAYS_EMPLOYED
shortlist_matrix.reason: Job tenure, a stability measure. Shorter tenure means higher default. Needs the 365243 placeholder replaced by missing plus a flag.

shortlist_matrix.name: DAYS_REGISTRATION
shortlist_matrix.reason: Time since the client changed registration: residential stability. Range 4.18 pp.

shortlist_matrix.name: DAYS_ID_PUBLISH
shortlist_matrix.reason: Time since the ID document was changed. Range 4.29 pp.

shortlist_matrix.name: OWN_CAR_AGE
shortlist_matrix.reason: 66% missing (structural: no car) and an unexplained spike at ages 64 and 65 (1,992 rows). Needs your view on the spike.

shortlist_matrix.name: FLAG_MOBIL
